title: Physical therapy exercises
what: Special exercises with an instructor watching. They are chosen for your problem, to bring back strength and movement.
why: For back and joint pain, after injuries and surgery, after a stroke, and for posture problems.
duration: one session usually takes 30 to 45 minutes. A course usually lasts several weeks
tell_doctor: Heart disease or blood pressure problems
If you recently had surgery or an injury
What hurts, and with which movements
If you feel dizzy when you exert yourself

prepare.title: Prescription
prepare.text: Sessions are usually prescribed by a doctor. The instructor builds a program based on the doctor's report.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Have a light snack 1 to 2 hours before. Do not exercise on a full stomach.

prepare.title: Clothes
prepare.text: Comfortable sportswear that lets you move freely, and clean indoor shoes.

steps: The instructor asks how you feel, and sometimes checks your blood pressure
The main exercises, done slowly and with control
The instructor shows you how to breathe and move correctly
At the end: relaxation and breathing exercises
feel: Mild tiredness in your muscles. This is normal
If you feel sharp pain, stop and tell the instructor
Your muscles may ache a little the next day
after: The instructor will give you exercises for home
Do them regularly. Results depend on keeping at it
If you feel worse after sessions, tell your doctor
red_flags: Chest pain, severe shortness of breath, or dizziness during a session: stop and call for help. Call emergency services if needed

faq.q: Can I do these exercises at home on my own?
faq.a: Yes, once the instructor has taught you and given you a program. The first sessions are best done with supervision.

faq.q: What if an exercise causes pain?
faq.a: Stop. Mild strain is normal, sharp pain is not. The instructor will swap the exercise.
